claimed_coverage: Tests socket directory creation (/run/bpfman-sock, /run/bpfman/csi) and logging initialization (env_logger/journald) that differentiate buggy code (serve() called directly, fails on missing dir) from fixed code (initialize_rpc() called first, creates dirs and inits logging).
fix_patch_grounding: The fix adds initialize_rpc() function that calls create_dir_all(RTDIR_SOCK) before serve(), and sets up logging via JournalLog or env_logger::try_init() with debug! output. Buggy code calls serve() directly without directory creation or logging init.
issue_context_used: Issue requires socket directory creation for CSI support and proper logging initialization for both journal and env_logger backends.
notes: Tests rewritten to properly discriminate buggy vs fixed: (1) Clean up socket dirs before testing to ensure fresh state, (2) Run actual binary (not --help) to trigger main() code path, (3) Check for 'No such file or directory' error (buggy) vs successful directory creation (fixed), (4) Check for 'Log using env_logger' or 'Log using journald' debug output. Buggy code fails immediately on socket bind; fixed code creates dirs first via initialize_rpc(). All 5 tests FAIL on buggy code and PASS on fixed code.
